title: Daily Briefing - Clicking on a Daily Briefing Does Nothing
summary: I have a premium archive subscription with daily briefings enabled. It says it’s generated my daily briefings (“yesterday; 18 stories”), but clicking on any of the generated daily briefings does not hydrate any view with the content, nor show a popup, nor open a details view, or similar. This is in Microsoft Edge, Windows 11, with all plugins and blocker/tracker blocking disabled.
body_markdown:
[Cary_Schwartzman](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/Cary_Schwartzman)

I have a premium archive subscription with daily briefings enabled. It says it’s generated my daily briefings (“yesterday; 18 stories”), but clicking on any of the generated daily briefings does not hydrate any view with the content, nor show a popup, nor open a details view, or similar.


This is in Microsoft Edge, Windows 11, with all plugins and blocker/tracker blocking disabled.
